dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and continuous 2D narrowing from the maximum mid-body width toward a slender posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are predominantly smooth with a slight asymmetrical inward curve on the lower left margin relative to the right.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median intensity across the dorsal surface with visible specular highlights on the anterior dorsal ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High spatial frequency of circular and oval light-toned patches (mottling) distributed extensively across the dorsal area, particularly concentrated in the mid-section.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient boundaries between the lighter mottled patches and the primary light-grey epidermal background.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple parallel longitudinal linear marks (rake marks) are visible running along the mid-dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (rake marks) and numerous circular de-pigmented patches across the majority of the visible dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, dark-toned circular blowhole aperture at the anterior dorsal apex.
